ncfc31d54f75.s: Which of the following pairs about the undivided AP-Telangana institutions is correctly matched?
o: Basis demanded by Telangana – population ratio
Number of undivided corporations and institutions – more than 140
Basis demanded by Andhra Pradesh – location
ncfc31d54f75.x: More than 140 corporations and institutions worth over Rs 39,000 crore remain undivided. Telangana insists on location, while AP seeks the 58:42 population ratio.

nfec327ea300.s: Which of the following pairs about the division between AP and Telangana is correctly matched?
o: Basis for dividing revenue assets – population
nfec327ea300.x: Debt was divided by population, so AP took 58% of it, while revenue assets were allocated by location and AP got only 46%.

nd6f46831124.s:
Consider the following statements about the division of tax arrears and refunds after bifurcation:
1. Arrears of property tax or land revenue are divided according to the State where the property lies.
2. Refunds of other taxes collected in excess are divided by population ratio.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
nd6f46831124.x: Both are true: property-tax arrears follow the property's location, while refunds of other taxes follow the population ratio.

n65e08bab9cb.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the three-capitals proposal of 2020?
o: Amaravati was to be the legislative capital
Visakhapatnam was to be the judicial capital
Kurnool was to be the judicial capital
Visakhapatnam was to be the executive capital
n65e08bab9cb.x: Visakhapatnam was proposed as the executive capital; the judicial capital was Kurnool and Amaravati the legislative one.

new.s: The appointed day under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 was:
new.x: The Act received assent on 1 March 2014 and the appointed day was 2 June 2014.

new.s: The financial division provisions of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 lie in which Sections?
new.x: Sections 47-64 deal with the apportionment of assets and liabilities; Sections 76-83 are about services.

new.s: Which fund was divided between AP and Telangana on the basis of area ratio, not population?
new.x: The Calamity Relief Fund is the only fund split by area ratio; most other items went by population or location.

new.s: Under Section 58, Provident Fund balances follow:
o: The State to which the employee is allotted
new.x: Provident Fund follows the State the employee is allotted to, not the population ratio.

new.s: Under the Twelfth Schedule, power from Central Generating Stations is shared on the basis of:
o: DISCOMs' actual consumption of the last 5 years
new.x: CGS power is shared on the DISCOMs' actual consumption of the last 5 years; APGENCO plants are divided by location.

new.s: How many Schedule X institutions did the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 list as enacted?
new.x: The Act as passed listed 107 Schedule X institutions; 35 more added in May 2015 made it 142. Schedule IX has 91.

new.s: How many government companies and corporations are listed in Schedule IX of the AP Reorganisation Act?
new.x: Schedule IX lists 91 government companies and corporations.

new.s: The continuance of facilities of Schedule X institutions for both States is governed by:
new.x: Section 75 governs Schedule X institutions; Sections 68 and 53 relate to Schedule IX bodies.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Schedule X of the AP Reorganisation Act?
o: It lists State institutions whose facilities continue for both States
Shilparamam Arts, Crafts and Cultural Society is listed in it
new.x: APSFC is a Schedule IX body; APSCHE and Shilparamam are Schedule X institutions.

new.s: The Kamalanathan Committee dealt with the allocation of:
new.x: C.R. Kamalanathan headed the committee on State-level employees; Pratyush Sinha handled All India Services.

new.s: The Sheela Bhide Committee recommended the division of how many of the 91 Schedule IX bodies?
new.x: It recommended division of 89 of the 91 Schedule IX bodies; Telangana opposed its recommendations on 22.

new.s:
Consider the following pairs of committees and their subjects:
1. Sheela Bhide Committee – Schedule IX companies and corporations
2. Pratyush Sinha Committee – All India Services officers
3. Kamalanathan Committee – Schedule X institutions
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
new.x: Sheela Bhide dealt with Schedule IX bodies and Pratyush Sinha with AIS officers; Kamalanathan dealt with State-level employees, not Schedule X.

new.s: Provisions as to Services in the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 are contained in:
new.x: Part VIII (Sections 76-83) is Provisions as to Services; Part XI covers higher education.

new.s: Which Section of the AP Reorganisation Act deals with State employees and does not apply to All India Services?
new.x: Section 77 covers State employees and does not apply to All India Services; Section 76 creates the AIS State cadres.

new.s: In March 2024, DoPT set up a one-member committee on AIS allotment cases headed by:
new.x: After the Telangana High Court's 3 January 2024 order, DoPT set up the one-member Deepak Khandekar committee in March 2024.

new.s: The Centre could set up Advisory Committees on employee allocation within how many days of enactment?
new.x: Advisory Committees could be set up within 30 days of enactment.

new.s: Section 95 of the AP Reorganisation Act, on access to higher education, is in:
new.x: Section 95 is in Part XI (Access to Higher Education); Part VIII is about services.

new.s: Which Section of the AP Reorganisation Act amended Article 371D to cover "Andhra Pradesh or Telangana"?
new.x: Section 97 amended Article 371D; Section 95 continued the admission quotas.

new.s: In the APSCHE case of 2016, the Supreme Court held that cash and bank balances should be divided by:
new.x: The 2016 APSCHE ruling applied location for assets and population ratio for cash and bank balances.

new.s: After the APSCHE ruling, the Union Home Ministry:
o: Applied the same formula to other Schedule X institutions
Referred all institutions to a High Court judge
Divided all institutions by area ratio
new.x: The Union Home Ministry applied the same APSCHE formula to other Schedule X institutions.

new.s: Under Section 70, if the APSFC division scheme is not approved by shareholders, it is referred to:
new.x: An approved scheme goes to the Centre for sanction; if not approved, it goes to a High Court judge, whose settlement is final.

new.s: Which body directed Andhra Pradesh to pay Telangana its share of the central subsidy credited to AP?
new.x: The Southern Zonal Council directed AP to pay Telangana its share, which remains unpaid.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the unresolved bifurcation issues?
o: APGENCO says Telangana's DISCOMs owe it for power supplied after bifurcation
Andhra Pradesh holds 49% equity in SCCL
APSFC division is pending under Section 70
new.x: SCCL equity is 51% Telangana and 49% Government of India, so AP holds no equity.

new.s: What was the Centre's calculation of Andhra Pradesh's 2014-15 resource gap?
new.x: The Centre calculated Rs 4,117.89 crore using standardised accounting; AP claimed Rs 16,078 crore and Rs 3,979.50 crore was released.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 2014-15 resource gap?
o: AP claimed a gap of Rs 16,078 crore
The Centre's figure excluded new commitments
The CAG issues the final order on disputes under Section 47(4)
new.x: Under Section 47(4) the Centre issues the order on the advice of the CAG; the CAG only advises.

new.s: The Special Assistance Measure for Andhra Pradesh was worth:
new.x: SAM was Rs 24,350 crore, within which the Rs 3,979 crore revenue deficit grant was counted.

new.s: Which Finance Commission removed the distinction between general and special category States?
new.x: The 14th Finance Commission (2015-20) removed the general/special category distinction.

new.s: Under the Special Assistance Measure, the Centre provided a 90% grant equivalent only for:
new.x: SAM gave a 90% grant equivalent only for Externally Aided Projects (EAPs).

new.s: Special Category Status for Andhra Pradesh was promised in Parliament for how many years?
new.x: SCS was promised for 5 years but denied, citing the 14th Finance Commission.

new.s: The special development package under Section 46(2)-(3) was meant especially for:
new.x: Section 46(2)-(3) provides grants and a special development package for backward areas, especially Rayalaseema and North Coastal AP.

new.s: Under Section 54, loans re-lent for an activity located in one State are:
new.x: Public debt goes by population ratio, but loans re-lent for an activity in one State stay with that State.

new.s: Deferred taxes of industrial units are allocated under Section 51(1) to:
o: The State where the unit is located
new.x: Section 51(1) assigns deferred taxes to the State where the industrial unit is located.

new.s: Arrears of taxes other than property taxes are divided on the basis of:
new.x: Arrears of other taxes follow the place of assessment (mostly Hyderabad), while their refunds follow population.

new.s: Pre-appointed-day pensions are divided between AP and Telangana in the ratio:
new.x: Under Section 59 and the Eighth Schedule, pensions are divided in the ratio 58.32 : 41.68.

new.s: On 29 August 2022, the Union Power Ministry ordered Telangana to pay Andhra Pradesh:
new.x: The order was for Rs 6,756.92 crore (principal Rs 3,441.78 crore plus surcharge) within 30 days.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the AP-Telangana power dues dispute:
1. Telangana counter-claimed Rs 12,940 crore.
2. The Telangana High Court set aside the Union Power Ministry's order in October 2023.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Telangana counter-claimed Rs 12,940 crore and its High Court set aside the order on 19 October 2023; AP appealed to the Supreme Court.

new.s: Under the Twelfth Schedule, what happened to existing power purchase agreements with DISCOMs?
o: They were renegotiated by population ratio
They were transferred to the Centre
new.x: APGENCO plants were divided by location and existing PPAs with DISCOMs continue.

new.s: Who headed the Capital City Advisory Committee set up by the AP government?
new.x: Municipal Administration Minister P. Narayana headed the State committee, which backed the Vijayawada-Guntur region.

new.s: Who chaired the Expert Committee constituted by the Centre under Section 6 of the AP Reorganisation Act?
new.x: The Centre's Sec 6 Expert Committee was chaired by K.C. Sivaramakrishnan; it reported in August 2014 and opposed a single super capital.

new.s: Under the AP Reorganisation Act, Hyderabad was to be the common capital for:
new.x: Section 5 made Hyderabad the common capital for 10 years.

new.s: The foundation stone of Amaravati was laid on 22 October 2015 at:
new.x: PM Narendra Modi laid the foundation stone at Uddandarayunipalem on the Krishna in Guntur district.

new.s: The APCRDA Act, 2014 came into force on:
new.x: The APCRDA Act came into force on 30 December 2014; land pooling was announced in January 2015.

new.s: By March 2015, farmers had given consent under the Land Pooling Scheme for about:
new.x: Consent for about 33,000 acres had been obtained by March 2015.

new.s: The AP High Court struck down the CRDA Repeal Act (2020), upholding Amaravati, on:
new.x: On 3 March 2022 the AP High Court struck down the CRDA Repeal Act (2020).

new.s: The Rs 1,000 crore released later under Section 94(3) went to:
o: Underground drainage works in Vijayawada and Guntur
new.x: Of the Rs 2,500 crore, Rs 1,500 crore was initial capital construction and Rs 1,000 crore went to UGD works in Vijayawada and Guntur.

new.s: The initial direct central grant for capital construction under Section 94(3) was:
new.x: The initial grant was Rs 1,500 crore, followed by Rs 1,000 crore, totalling Rs 2,500 crore.

new.s: According to the Finance Ministry, the balance Rs 1,000 crore was to be released only after:
o: Utilisation certificates for the Rs 1,500 crore
NITI Aayog approval of the master plan
new.x: The Finance Ministry released the balance in phases only after utilisation certificates for the Rs 1,500 crore.

new.s: In 2018, Andhra Pradesh claimed which body had not rejected its utilisation certificates?
new.x: AP's position in 2018 was that NITI Aayog did not reject its UCs; the Centre said the UCs were incorrect.

new.s: HUDCO's term loan for Amaravati's urban infrastructure amounts to:
new.x: HUDCO gives Rs 11,000 crore; NaBFID Rs 7,500 crore and NABARD (NIDA) Rs 7,387.70 crore.

new.s: The Union Budget 2024-25 promised Rs 15,000 crore for Amaravati in the form of:
new.x: The Budget promised Rs 15,000 crore of Centre-facilitated multilateral support.

new.s: Central approval for State loans backed by sovereign guarantees for the capital is required under:
new.x: Loans with sovereign guarantees need approval under Article 293(2).
